reason: The first thing I thought was that I don't want an app negotiating or pitching businesses in my name. Free to start I might try, but I'm not paying ₹299 a month for something I haven't seen move my views.
objection: Who is it actually talking to when it pitches shops and coaching centres for me, and will it ask before it sends anything?
would_change_my_mind: A free trial that shows it beat my usual views on a real video, plus a written promise that nothing goes to any business without my explicit OK.
